title: GCC LaserPro FMC-280 laser machine with green-lit work chamber
objects_and_counts: One large freestanding laser machine occupies the center of the image; the machine has visible brand and model markings.
One rectangular viewing window with green illumination is centered on the upper half of the machine; the window has two black horizontal handles visible at its bottom edge.
One circular red emergency stop button is visible on the machine's right-side control column, directly under a small red sign.

One open cardboard box is visible at the bottom left corner; objects inside the box are partially obscured/cropped and not individually countable.
One metal or composite table/workbench is partially visible and cropped at the right edge of the image.
